description: Keep agent GitHub access on the App wrappers. Review and trust in /hooks before use.

hooks.command: guard_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && test -f "$guard_root/.codex/hooks/agent-credential-guard.sh" || { printf "%s\n" "Codex credential guard: launcher unavailable; refusing the call." >&2; exit 2; }; exec /bin/bash "$guard_root/.codex/hooks/agent-credential-guard.sh"
